# Proof & Realness

Legend: [D] demonstrated · [A] anticipated · [T] target.

- [D] The earlier Patron Fish run happened: "we already did a patron fish yeah day ... that was get the website approach the first two test patron fish" (the only past action treated as done; scale and the website-only result are stated, not shown to this group).
- [D] A risk was caught earlier: "there might be a potential hack of the um the the lottery ... that got picked up on november the fifth and some pilot we did" (asserted as found; remediation unverified within this transcript).
- [A] Presenting the fix as strengthening proof: "we're going to present this to the crypto economic people ... saying well we fixed that bug right."
- [T] The explicit measure: "the proof and evidence that this is working is money money and the number of people pitch to and that we've actually gone out and pitched to people ... proper money people not just put a website out and hope."

**Headline metric.** Dollars actually raised and the number of real "proper money people" actually pitched to.
